description: Unauthorized fishing within a Galápagos no-take protected zone (Zone 2.1).
penalty_text: Civil penalty of USD 80,000 base, with multipliers for prior offenses (×1.25) and AIS-disabling (×1.5).

description: Vessels operating in IATTC convention area must appear on the Regional Vessel Register (resolution C-19-01).

machine_check.trigger: vessel.authorizations does not include any IATTC-* entry

penalty_text: Civil penalty of USD 25,000 plus listing on the IATTC IUU Vessel List.

description: Continuous AIS transmission required for all vessels ≥300 GT under SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 19.

machine_check.trigger: GAP event with duration_hours > 0 inside protected area

penalty_text: Civil penalty of USD 15,000 per incident.

description: Port State must deny entry to vessels engaged in IUU fishing per FAO Port State Measures Agreement Article 9(4).
penalty_text: Denial of port entry; inspection-on-arrival; potential vessel detention.

description: Coastal-state enforcement rights within exclusive economic zones under UNCLOS Article 73.

machine_check.trigger: vessel inside EEZ AND vessel.flag != EEZ.country

penalty_text: Authority for boarding, inspection, arrest, and judicial proceedings against the offending vessel.

description: Definitional anchor for 'illegal, unreported, and unregulated' fishing (IPOA-IUU paragraph 3).
penalty_text: Voluntary instrument; provides interpretive framework rather than direct penalty.
